text:
```yaml
name: Release Beta

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install

      - name: Fix CWD issue
        run: echo "cd \"$PROJECT_ROOT\"" >> .npmrc

      - name: Publish beta version
        run: yarn release --prerelease --preid beta --no-git-tag-version --no-commit-hooks

      - name: Clean up git tags
        run: |
          git tag -d plugin-idfa-v0.7.3
          git push origin :refs/tags/plugin-idfa-v0.7.3
          git tag plugin-adjust-v0.8.0 9cd342c4
          git tag plugin-advertising-id-v1.3.5 6e14e85c
          git tag plugin-advertising-id-v1.3.6 409f9541
          git tag plugin-amplitude-session-v0.4.1 71234792
          git tag plugin-branch-v1.1.2 e079c719
          git tag plugin-braze-v0.7.0 e079c719
          git tag plugin-braze-v0.8.0 e4a90b64
          git tag plugin-braze-v0.9.0 409f9541
          git tag plugin-firebase-v0.4.3 6ffd96d3
          git tag plugin-idfa-v0.7.3 7e9023a9
          git push origin --tags

      - name: Push changes
        run: git push origin master
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file `.github/workflows/release-beta.yml` is designed to handle the creation of beta pre-release versions for the `segmentio/analytics-react-native` repository. The workflow includes steps to fix the CWD issue, publish a beta version using semantic-release, clean up git tags, and push changes to the repository.
